items.t: A strong diagonal from bottom left to top right, the action climbing it.
Everything happening in the bottom third, empty room above.
Frame within a frame: a doorway, a window, a mirror holding the real subject.
Foreground object out of focus and enormous, the people small behind it.
Triangular arrangement, but one corner is {4}.
Leading lines from floorboards or a table edge pointing at the wrong person.
Figures pushed to the far left, the right half of the frame is what they are all looking at.
Repetition. Three of the same object, three of the same gesture, one broken.
Silhouette against a light wall, details only in the edges.
Two thirds of the frame is ceiling. The people are at the bottom, small.
The subject is cut in half by the frame edge on purpose.
A circle of people seen from above, feet pointing in, one pair of feet pointing out.
